rotation_note: Unattended-run override: NO rotating subset. All 3 core keywords plus the entire politics pool (34 keywords, grouped into policy_regulation / elections_public_opinion / geopolitics) are working keywords today (37 total). Day-of-year 324 sets ORDER only: group lead rotates so no group leads twice in a row (geopolitics led 11-18, policy_regulation led 11-19, so elections_public_opinion leads today, then geopolitics, then policy_regulation); within each group the list starts at offset 324 % group_size in pool order (elections 324 % 9 = 0: election deepfake first; geopolitics 324 % 10 = 4: compute diplomacy first; policy 324 % 15 = 9: AI procurement rules first). Queries were not checked with WebSearch (budget reserved for librarians); librarians should prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds over site: search for recency. Window: last brief was 2026-11-19, so items published 11-19 (after the prior harvest) through 11-20 are in scope. Context: Friday 11-20 in Korea / Thursday 11-19 in the US and EU at harvest time — expect US agency releases, court orders and Federal Register public-inspection items dated 11-19, EU Thursday items, plus Korean Friday releases dated 11-20. Hooks — only official documents/actions are new, skip previews and reactions: Meta AI-scraping terms take effect TODAY 11-20 (Brazil court suspension covered 11-05; only a NEW regulator/court order in another jurisdiction, or Meta formally changing/pausing the terms, is new); 중기부 모두의 창업 AI vendor security audit due 11-20 (only published results/sanctions are new); 수능 was 11-19 — only an official 교육부/경찰 count of AI-device cheating cases, an arrest/charge, a filed 특별법 with bill number, or a 시행령 change is new (the 11-16/11-17 measures are covered); APEC Shenzhen US-China summit ended 11-19 (only a signed joint statement / leaders' declaration AI text / formal AI-incident channel launch is new, no previews or readouts of 'talks'); CCW 7th Review Conference Geneva closes 11-20 (only adopted decisions/mandate on autonomous weapons or formal national statements posted by UNODA are new — may land after harvest); Nvidia halting licensed H200 shipments to China (covered 11-19; only a BIS/Commerce action, a MOFCOM response, or a congressional subpoena/bill is new); Oregon AG $2.035B ChatGPT kids suit (covered 11-19; only a court order, OpenAI's formal response, or another state AG suit is new); UK BIST committee 'Guardrails for Growth' AI Safety and Security Bill call (covered 11-19; only the government's formal response or a bill introduced is new); Saskatchewan Prevention of Deceptive AI Act (covered 11-19; only passage/royal assent or another province's bill is new); Ofqual AI/wearables letter (covered 11-19; responses due 11-30, only the NEA consultation launch is new). In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, commentary without a new document. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
